text:
Jordan: Heads up — PR #1984 is ready for merge but macos-e2e has been failing 3x in a row. Need to decide merge timing before the deploy blackout tonight.
Sam: Ack. CI queue shows mac builders stuck behind a long matrix. ETA ~1.5h for free mac slots. Can we avoid rebasing if possible?
Lee: If it's only flaky tests we could gate behind a feature flag, but last I checked this PR includes a db migration so flagging isn't clean.
Jordan: Correct — migration needs to land in maintenance window. Alternative is rebase to pick up the flaky-test fix on main. Rebase will drop approvals though.
ci-bot: CI Update: macos-e2e job rerun #4 started.
Maria: I can triage the failure in ~30m. @Sam can you paste the failing log lines?
Sam: Sure — failing assertion below:
```
--- FAIL: TestRender (0.12s)
render_test.go:87: expected '2026-03-17T...' got '2026-03-17T...' (timezone mismatch)
```
Sam: Looks like a timezone-dependent flake on macos only.
Lee: Are we within the allowed rebase window? I thought maintenance/rebase window closes at 21:45 UTC and soft-freeze at 23:00 UTC.
Jordan: We have until 21:30 UTC to get green and merge safely. If not, we either get an exception from @release-leads or defer to the next window.
Sam: Can eng-sre kick a cross-region rerun on apac mac runners? They looked free earlier.
eng-sre: On it — starting apac-mac rerun (job 1712456805). Will report back.
Maria: Quick note: if we rebase approvals will be invalidated. We'll need fresh approvals from @qa and @pm once green.
Jordan: I'll ping release-leads now to request exemption if reruns don't finish. Meanwhile @Maria please dig into the timezone assertion, @Lee prep a rebase branch in case we need it.
Maria: Found the flaky expectation — will push a tiny patch to normalize timezone in the test (small change, no prod impact). Pushing to the PR branch now.
ci-bot: CI Update: apac-mac rerun completed -> macos-e2e passed.
Jordan: Nice. @Sam can you trigger a full matrix rerun and ping reviewers? If green we can merge before freeze.
Sam: Kicking full matrix now (ETA ~15m). @everyone please stand by.
Jordan: Thanks all — will coordinate with release-leads if anything slips. :rocket:
